text:
katie: Quick thread  we need a concise decision on response envelope for next sprint. key asks from customers: stable trace across tool calls, clear token fields that match billing, and a tiny opt-in telemetry namespace.

leo: tl;dr proposal: prefix rw_ for vendor fields. rw_trace_id (128-bit hex), rw_request_id (attempt id), rw_input_tokens, rw_output_tokens, rw_total_tokens. keep telemetry flat: rw_model, rw_latency_ms, rw_region.

maria: important: streaming semantics. each chunk may report rw_partial_output_tokens; final chunk must include rw_output_tokens and rw_total_tokens. document how to sum chunks vs final.

vikram: tool-calls: gateway should inject rw_trace_id into tool payloads and expect it back. retries get new rw_request_id but same rw_trace_id. this enables cross-service logs.

katie: rollout strategy idea: new tenants get envelope by default; existing tenants behind a gateway feature flag for 60 days. provide console preview + migration helper that samples token diffs.

leo: acceptance checklist (short): SDK surfaces rw_* fields, docs with examples for chat/embeddings/rerank/structured, e2e that verifies trace across tool calls, and a billing reconciliation guide.

docs-bot: docs: lint OK, schema-tests queued.

katie: owners: eng (vikram/leo) PR for flag + tests, product (maria) migration docs, comms (katie) draft. ack?

leo: ACK, PR by Wed.

maria: ACK, migration doc by Thu.

vikram: ACK, will include e2e trace test.
